examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā rajena ca malena ca pariyonaddhā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā na c'eva paribhuñjeyyuṃ na ca pariyodapeyyuṃ, raj'āpathe ca naṃ nikkhipeyyuṃ.
so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, idaṃ kho, bhante, āyasmantaṃ uddissa cīvaracetāpannaṃ ābhataṃ, paṭiggaṇhātu āyasmā cīvaracetāpannan'ti.
vicittavatth'ābharaṇā, āmuttamaṇikuṇḍalā, kusalā naccagītassa, sakkassa paricārikā.
kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya, abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ, kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ, vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te.

12005.meaning1: radiant; shining; belonging to the radiant heaven; epithet of a class of devas
12005.synonym: aṅgīrasī, ābha, candaka, nibhāsī, pabha, pabhassara, bhassara, sobha, sobhana, sobhī
12005.commentary: (DNa) ābhassarā'ti daṇḍaukkāya acci viya etesaṃ sarīrato ābhā chijjitvā chijjitvā patantī viya sarati vissaratī'ti ābhassarā.

examples.text: susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no n'atthi kiñcanaṃ, pītibhakkhā bhavissāma, devā ābhassarā yathā.

ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ābhassarānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.
vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ pātubhavati. atha kho aññataro satto āyukkhayā vā puññakkhayā vā ābhassarakāyā cavitvā suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjati.

12007.meaning1: radiance; effulgence; fact of being a radiant deity
12007.construction:
ā + √bhās > bhass + ara + tta
ābhassara + tta

examples.text: viññāṇaṃ anidassanaṃ anantaṃ sabbato pabhaṃ, taṃ… ābhassarānaṃ ābhassarattena ananubhūtaṃ, subhakiṇhānaṃ subhakiṇhattena ananubhūtaṃ, vehapphalānaṃ vehapphalatte ananubhūtaṃ, abhibhussa abhibhuttena ananubhūtaṃ, sabbassa sabbattena ananubhūtaṃ.

12008.meaning1: reborn in the world of the radiant gods
12008.commentary: (DNa) yebhuyyenā'ti ye uparibrahmalokesu vā arūpesu vā nibbattanti, tadavasese sandhāya vuttaṃ.

examples.text: hoti kho so, bhikkhave, samayo, yaṃ kadāci karahaci dīghassa addhuno accayena ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati. saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti.

12009.construction:
ā + √bhās > bhass + ara + ā
ābhassara + ā
12009.commentary: (DNa) paṇītaṃ bhāvetvā upapannā ābhassarā nāma honti, tesaṃ aṭṭha kappā āyuppamāṇaṃ.

examples.text: ābhassare ābhassarato sañjānāti, ābhassare ābhassarato saññatvā ābhassare maññati, ābhassaresu maññati, ābhassarato maññati, ābhassare me'ti maññati, ābhassare abhinandati. taṃ kissa hetu? apariññātaṃ tassā'ti vadāmi.
atthi kho, brahme, añño kāyo, taṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, tam'ahaṃ jānāmi passāmi. atthi kho, brahme, ābhassarā nāma kāyo yato tvaṃ cuto idh'ūpapanno.

12010.meaning1: living in the radiant (world of the gods); experiencing the shining (deva realm)
12010.commentary: (ITIa) ābhassar'ūpago'ti tattha paṭisandhiggahaṇavasena ābhassarabrahmalokaṃ upagacchāmī'ti ābhassar'ūpago homi.

examples.text: satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, telappadīpassa jhāyato acciṃ paṭicca ābhā paññāyati, ābhaṃ paṭicca acci paññāyati, evam'eva kho, āvuso, āyu usmaṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhati, usmā āyuṃ paṭicca tiṭṭhatī'ti.
atthi, bhikkhave, lok'antarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yattham'imesaṃ candimasūriyānaṃ evaṃmah'iddhikānaṃ evaṃ mah'ānubhāvānaṃ ābhāya n'ānubhontī'ti.
divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā, sannaddho khattiyo tapati, jhāyī tapati brāhmaṇo, atha sabbam'ahorattiṃ, buddho tapati tejasā.
cattāro loke pajjotā, pañcam'ettha na vijjati, divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā.

12013.meaning1: state of radiance; element of luminosity
12013.commentary: (SNa) ābhādhātū'ti ālokadhātu. ālokassa'pi ālokakasiṇe parikammaṃ katvā uppannajjhānassāpīti sahārammaṇassa jhānassa etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññāyatanadhātu yā ca nevasaññānāsaññāyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

12014.meaning1: difference in light; diversity in radiance

examples.text: tesaṃ ekaṃ gharaṃ pavesitānaṃ accinānattañ'hi kho paññāyetha, no ca ābhānānattaṃ, evam'eva kho, gahapati, hoti kho so samayo, yā tā devatā ekajjhaṃ sannipatanti tāsaṃ ekajjhaṃ sannipatitānaṃ vaṇṇanānattañ'hi kho paññāyati, no ca ābhānānattaṃ.

12021.meaning1: higher state of consciousness; higher state of mind
12021.commentary: (MNa) ābhicetasikānan'ti abhiceto'ti abhikkantaṃ visuddhacittaṃ vuccati, adhicittaṃ vā, abhicetasi jātāni ābhicetasikāni, abhiceto sannissitānī'ti vā ābhicetasikāni.

examples.text: imesañ'ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
yato ca kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu… catunnañ'ca jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī… evaṃ so ten'aṅgena paripūro hoti.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, addasaṃ bhaṇḍuñ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ ābhijjikañ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ aññam'aññaṃ sutena accāvadante, ehi, bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī'ti.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, addasaṃ bhaṇḍuñ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ ānandassa saddhivihāriṃ ābhiñjikañ'ca nāma bhikkhuṃ anuruddhassa saddhivihāriṃ aññam'aññaṃ sutena accāvadante, ehi, bhikkhu, ko bahutaraṃ bhāsissati, ko sundarataraṃ bhāsissati, ko cirataraṃ bhāsissatī'ti.

12024.meaning1: from last night; from the previous evening; (comm) (or) contaminated; turning rotten
12024.commentary: (MNa) ābhidosikan'ti pārivāsikaṃ ekaratt'ātikkantaṃ pūtibhūtaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ pad'attho, pūtibhāvadosena abhibhūto'ti abhidoso, abhidoso'va ābhidosiko. ekaratt'ātikkantass'eva nāmasaññā esā yadidaṃ ābhidosiko'ti, taṃ ābhidosikaṃ

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato raṭṭhapālassa ñātidāsī ābhidosikaṃ kummāsaṃ chaḍḍetu'kāmā hoti. atha kho āyasmā raṭṭhapālo taṃ ñātidāsiṃ etadavoca, sac'etaṃ, bhagini, chaḍḍanīyadhammaṃ, idha me patte ākirā'ti.

12025.meaning2: of the previous evening, of last night

12026.meaning1: one well versed in the Abhidhamma; teacher of the 'higher' doctrine

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khīrarukkho assattho vā nigrodho vā pilakkho vā udumbaro vā daharo taruṇo komārako. tam'enaṃ puriso tiṇhāya kuṭhāriyā yato yato ābhindeyya āgaccheyya khīran'ti? evaṃ, bhante.

12028.meaning1: related to excellent conduct; regarding points of etiquette
12028.construction:
abhi > ābhi + saṃ + ā + √car > cār + *a + *ika
abhisamācāra + *ika

examples.text: kiṃ pan'imass'āyasmato āraññikassa ekass'āraññe serivihārena, yo ayam'āyasmā ābhisamācārikam'pi dhammaṃ na jānātī'ti, tassa bhavanti vattāro.

12029.meaning1: fulfilling of matters related to excellent conduct
12029.commentary: (DNt) kāmaṃ ādibrahmacariyaka-dhammassavanena'pi mettākāyakammāni labbhanti, nippariyāyato pana cārittadhammassavanena ayam'attho icchito'ti dassento ābhisamācārika-dhammapūraṇan'ti āha.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sekho bhikkhu yāyaṃ kathā ābhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā… evarūpiyā kathāya na nikāmalābhī hoti na akicchalābhī na akasiralābhī, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.

12031.meaning2: concerned with austerity, with strict abstinence

12032.meaning1: fit for inauguration; worthy of coronation
12032.commentary: (ANa) ābhiseko'ti abhisekaṃ kātuṃ yutto. anabhisitto'ti na tāva abhisitto.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo āsaṃso? idha, bhikkhave, rañño khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa jeṭṭho putto hoti ābhiseko anabhisitto acalappatto. so suṇāti, itthan'nāmo kira khattiyo khattiyehi khattiy'ābhisekena abhisitto'ti.
dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā cūḷapanthako bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni

12040.commentary: (DNa) cetaso ābhogo'ti jhānā vuṭṭhāya tasmiṃ sukhe punappunaṃ cittassa ābhogo manasikāro samannāhāro'ti.

examples.text: yadeva tattha sukham'iti cetaso ābhogo, eten'etaṃ oḷārikaṃ akkhāyati.

12041.meaning2: ?? coming together of ideas; collection of meditations

12042.synonym: api, āmo, eva, khu, kho, byā, vata, hi

examples.text: tena vattabbo, passasī'ti. āma passāmī'ti. āyatiṃ saṃvareyyāsī'ti
iti puṭṭho, no'ti vadeyya. tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyyuṃ, ambho purisa, yaṃ tvaṃ na jānāsi na passasi, tassa tvaṃ pāsādassa ārohaṇāya nisseṇiṃ karosī'ti? iti puṭṭho, āmā'ti vadeyya.

12043.commentary: (ANa) ām'āvasesaṃ pācetī'ti sace ām'āvasesakaṃ hoti, taṃ pāceti.

examples.text: pañc'ime, bhikkhave, ānisaṃsā yāguyā. katame pañca? khuddaṃ paṭihanati, pipāsaṃ paṭivineti, vātaṃ anulometi, vatthiṃ sodheti, āma-avasesaṃ pāceti. ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā yāguyā'ti.
alīnacitto ca siyā, na c'āpi bahu cintaye, nirāmagandho asito, brahmacariyaparāyaṇo.

12045.commentary: (ANa) āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇī'ti āmakaṃ hutvā olokentānaṃ pakkasadisaṃ khāyati. evaṃ sabbapadāni daṭṭhabbāni.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇi, pakkaṃ āmavaṇṇi, āmaṃ āmavaṇṇi, pakkaṃ pakkavaṇṇi, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri ambāni. evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, cattāro amb'ūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

12048.commentary: (MNa) āmakacchinno'ti atitaruṇakāle chinno, so hi vāt'ātapena saṃphusati c'eva milāyati ca.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

12049.meaning1: (of clay) raw; damp; unbaked; not fired

examples.text: na vo ahaṃ, ānanda, tathā parakkamissāmi yathā kumbhakāro āmake āmakamatte. niggayha niggayh'āhaṃ, ānanda, vakkhāmi.

12050.meaning1: picked when green; plucked when not ripe
12050.commentary: (MNa) āmakacchinno'ti atitaruṇakāle chinno, so hi vāt'ātapena saṃphusati c'eva milāyati ca.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena saṃphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

12052.commentary: (VIN) āmakadhaññaṃ nāma sāli vīhi yavo godhumo kaṅgu varako kudrusako.

examples.text: āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

12053.commentary: (MNa) āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā'ti sāli-vīhi-yava-godhūma-kaṅgu-varaka-kudrūsaka-saṅkhātassa sattavidhassā'pi āmakadhaññassa paṭiggahaṇā. na kevalañ'ca etesaṃ paṭiggahaṇam'eva, āmasanam'pi bhikkhūnaṃ na vaṭṭati'y'eva.

examples.text: jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

12056.meaning2: raw; unbaked; not dry clay vessel
12056.commentary: (MNa) āmake'ti apakke. āmakamatte'ti āmake n'ātisukkhe bhājane. kumbhakāro hi āmakaṃ n'ātisukkhaṃ apakkaṃ ubhohi hatthehi saṇhikaṃ gaṇhāti mā bhijjatū'ti. iti yathā kumbhakāro tattha paṭipajjati, n'āhaṃ tumhesu tathā paṭipajjissāmi. (MNt) āmakamattan'ti kulālabhājanaṃ vuccati.

examples.text: na vo ahaṃ, ānanda, tathā parakkamissāmi yathā kumbhakāro āmake āmakamatte. niggayha niggayh'āhaṃ, ānanda, vakkhāmi.
āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato hoti

12058.meaning1: accepting uncooked meat; receiving raw flesh
12058.commentary: (MNa) āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā'ti ettha aññatra odissa anuññātā āmakamaṃsamacchānaṃ paṭiggahaṇam'eva bhikkhūnaṃ na vaṭṭati, no āmasanaṃ.

examples.text: jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakadhaññapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, āmakamaṃsapaṭiggahaṇā paṭivirato ahosiṃ

12061.meaning2: charnel grove, where corpses are thrown to be eaten by wild animals

12062.meaning1: odour of raw meat; stench of carrion; smell of rank flesh

examples.text: pāṇ'ātipāto vadhachedabandhanaṃ, theyyaṃ musāvādo nikativañcanāni ca, ajjhenakuttaṃ paradārasevanā, es'āmagandho na hi maṃsabhojanaṃ.

12066.commentary: (VINa) tattha yañ'ca vuttaṃ, āmasanā nāma āmaṭṭhamattā'ti yañ'ca chupanaṃ nāma phuṭṭhamattan'ti, imesaṃ ayaṃ viseso, āmasanā'ti āmajjanā phuṭṭh'okāsaṃ anatikkamitvā'pi tatth'eva saṅghaṭṭanā. ayañ'hi āmaṭṭhamattā'ti vuccati. chupanan'ti asaṅghaṭṭetvā phuṭṭhamattaṃ.

12067.commentary: (MNa) āmaṇḍan'ti āmalakaṃ. yathā taṃ parisuddhacakkhussa purisassa sabbaso'va pākaṭaṃ hoti, evaṃ tassa brahmuno saddhiṃ tattha nibbattasattehi sahassī lokadhātu. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso ekaṃ āmaṇḍaṃ hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya, evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, sahasso brahmā sahassilokadhātuṃ pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati. ye'pi tattha sattā upapannā te'pi pharitvā adhimuccitvā viharati.
atha kho, bhikkhave, gāvo majjhegaṅgāya nadiyā sote āmaṇḍaliyaṃ karitvā tatth'eva anayabyasanaṃ āpajjiṃsu. taṃ kissa hetu?

12070.meaning1: almost dead, near to death; begun to die

examples.text: yadā so āmato hoti, ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, tena hi, bho, imaṃ purisaṃ uttānaṃ nipātetha, app'eva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā'ti. te taṃ purisaṃ uttānaṃ nipātenti.

12071.meaning2: pot-seller's stall, shop or stall for pots

examples.text: āmantanā hoti sahāyamajjhe, vāse ṭhāne gamane cārikāya, anabhijjhitaṃ seritaṃ pekkhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

12076.synonym: ārocayati, āroceti, pāvadati, pilapati, vadati, sāvayati

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, handa dāni, bhikkhave, āmantayāmi vo, vayadhammā saṅkhārā appamādena sampādethā'ti. ayaṃ tathāgatassa pacchimā vācā.
bhavam'atthu bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ, rājā disampati bhavantaṃ jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati, rājā disampati bhoto jotipālassa māṇavassa dassanakāmo'ti

12078.commentary: (DNa) tato āmantayī'ti pubbe vuttagātham'eva nāmagottakittan'atthāya āha. tumhe ete vijānātha, passatha, oloketha, ye vo'haṃ kittayissāmī'ti ayam'ettha sambandho.

examples.text: tañ'ca sabbaṃ abhiññāya, vavatthitvāna cakkhumā, tato āmantayī satthā, sāvake sāsane rate.
mutto ca so poris'ādassa hatthā, gantvā sakaṃ mandiraṃ kāmakāmī, taṃ saṅkaraṃ brāhmaṇassappadāya, āmantayī puttam'alīnasattaṃ.
idha, mahārāja, purisassa kāye medo gaṇṭhi uppajjeyya. so tena rogena dukkhito upaddavā parimuccitu'kāmo bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ āmantāpeyya.

12081.commentary: (DNa) sārathiṃ āmantāpetvā'ti rājā kira nemittakehi kathitakālato paṭṭhāya ohitasoto vicarati, so kumāro uyyānaṃ gacchanto antarāmagge nivatto'ti sutvā sārathiṃ āmantāpesi.

examples.text: atha kho pāyāsi rājañño uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca, saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi, imin'āhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññam'eva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin'ti
sārathiṃ āmantāpetvā'ti rājā kira nemittakehi kathitakālato paṭṭhāya ohitasoto vicarati, so, kumāro uyyānaṃ gacchanto antarāmagge nivatto'ti sutvā sārathiṃ āmantāpesi.
bhikkhavo'ti tesaṃ āmantanākāradassanaṃ. bhadante'ti āmantitānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gāravena satthu paṭivacanadānaṃ. tattha bhikkhavo'ti vadanto bhagavā te bhikkhū ālapati.
